LESSON: GIFTS OF NATURE

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: General
Strand: Creation 1. 1 Creation in Buddh and Sikh faiths (8 lessons) • Scriptural stories
Topic 1.2: Gifts of Nature

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Gifts of Nature. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Gifts of Nature
2. Practise Gifts of Nature at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Gifts of Nature

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Gifts of Nature
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Gifts of Nature. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Gifts of Nature at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Gifts of Nature at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Gifts of Nature
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Gifts of Nature. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Gifts of Nature using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Gifts of Nature in the examples.
2. Explain Gifts of Nature to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Gifts of Nature.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Gifts of Nature using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Gifts of Nature important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Gifts of Nature
2. Practise Gifts of Nature at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Gifts of Nature

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
